title: Bitcoin's 2017 bull run and 2018 crash
summary: BTC 2017-18 cycle (Bitstamp daily): peak close $19,188 (2017-12-16), trough $3,180 (2018-12-15), -83%. RSI peaked at 94. Death cross 2018-03-31. $6k support held Feb-Oct 2018 and broke in Nov 2018. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: Strategy overview (paper trading only)
summary: Global rules (top-20 universe, max 1% risk per trade, stop and target logged before entry, 2:1 minimum reward:risk, -3% daily loss limit, no leverage or shorting) plus four strategies: trend following, Donchian breakout, RSI/Bollinger mean reversion, and DCA as the benchmark. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: S1 trend rule tested on Bitcoin's 2017 boom and 2018 crash
summary: Playbook S1 on Bitstamp BTC daily, 2017 to Mar 2019, $2,000 paper account with 1% risk: ended $2,379 (+19%), worst drawdown -4.5%, 16 trades (62% winners). Buy and hold made +286% but fell about 83%. The trend filter sat in cash after the 2018-03-31 death cross. One coin, one cycle, in-sample, so not proof. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: Bitcoin 2020-2021: COVID crash, halving, and the double top
summary: BTC 2020-21 cycle (Bitstamp daily): COVID crash close $4,842 (2020-03-12, -39% day, RSI 15.7). Golden cross 2020-05-21. Tops: $63,564 close (2021-04-13) and $67,559 close / $69,000 intraday (2021-11-08/10) on weaker RSI. $30k support held through July 2021. Death cross 2021-06-19, golden 2021-09-15, death again 2022-01-15. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: Bitcoin 2022-2023: the crypto-credit bear market and the recovery
summary: BTC 2022-23 bear (Bitstamp daily): Terra/UST (2022-05-09, -11.6%), Celsius (2022-06-13, -15.6%, worst day), FTX (2022-11-09, -14.4%). Cycle low close $15,766 (2022-11-21), -77% from the Nov 2021 top. Golden cross 2023-02-07; year-end 2023 close $42,258. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: S1 trend rule re-tested on Bitcoin 2020-2022
summary: Same S1 rules on Bitstamp BTC daily, 2020-2022, $2,000 paper account, 1% risk: ended $2,302 (+15%), worst drawdown -3.8%, 15 trades (53% winners, avg +1.0R). Buy and hold +131% with a -77% drawdown; weekly DCA -10%. No trades in 2022 after the death cross. Still only BTC, so not proof. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: Ethereum 2016-2018: the DAO hack, the ICO boom, and the 2018 bust
summary: ETH 2016–18 cycle (Coinbase daily): DAO hack 2016-06-17/18 (−25% two days in a row). Golden cross 2017-02-19; 2017 gain ~91×. China ICO ban 2017-09-04. Top close $1,386 (2018-01-13), four weeks after BTC's. Death cross 2018-04-10. Floors $370–400 (Apr–Jul 2018) and $180–200 (Sep–Nov 2018) both broke. Low close $83 (2018-12-14), −94% vs BTC's −83%. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: S1 trend rule tested on Ethereum 2017-2018
summary: S1 on ETH 2017-2018 (Coinbase daily): $2,000 to $2,567 (+28%), worst drawdown -5.8%, 19 trades (37% winners, avg +1.4R, best +11.1R). Buy & hold ended about 17x but fell 94% from its top; weekly DCA +82%. No trades after the 2018-04-10 death cross. The 2017-06-21 GDAX flash crash to $0.10 led to new playbook rule G11 (slippage events). Educational only, not financial advice.

title: Ethereum 2020-2022: COVID crash, DeFi summer, the 2021 double top, the Merge, and the crypto-credit bust
summary: ETH 2020–22 cycle (Coinbase daily): COVID crash close $110 (2020-03-12, −43% day). Golden cross 2020-05-14. DeFi summer (COMP, June 2020), Beacon Chain 2020-12-01, CME ether futures 2021-02-08. Tops: $4,180 close (2021-05-11) and $4,812 close (2021-11-08) on weaker RSI (70 vs 83) and lower volume. China ban day 2021-05-19 −28%. $1.7–1.85k floor May–Jul 2021, later resistance near $2k in Aug 2022. Death cross 2022-01-28. Low close $994 (2022-06-18, RSI 19.6), −79%. Merge 2022-09-15 was 'sell the news' (−10% day). FTX −15%/−18% on 11-08/09 held above June low. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: S1 trend rule tested on Ethereum 2020-2022
summary: S1 on ETH 2020-2022 (Coinbase daily): $2,000 to $2,362 (+18%), worst drawdown -3.9%, 18 trades (50% winners, avg +1.0R, best +5.8R). Buy & hold about 9x with a -79% drawdown; weekly DCA +101%. Exited 2021-05-17, two days before the China-ban crash, and took no trades after the 2022-01-28 death cross. Educational only, not financial advice.

title: XRP 2020-2023: airdrop frenzy, the SEC lawsuit, the 2021 top, a 14-month range, and the July 2023 ruling
summary: XRP 2020–23 cycle (Bitstamp daily): COVID close $0.141 (2020-03-12, −32%). Spark airdrop top $0.694 (2020-11-24, RSI 93). SEC sued Ripple 2020-12-22; 2020-12-23 −42% (worst day). Telegram pump +57% (2021-01-30), mostly faded. Top close $1.834 (2021-04-14); no new high in Nov 2021 when BTC/ETH did. Death crosses 2021-07-18 and 2021-12-31. Low close $0.308 (2022-06-18), −83%. Range $0.31–0.54 May 2022–Jul 2023. Torres ruling 2023-07-13 +73% (close $0.816), −12% next day; old $0.52–0.55 ceiling then acted as support. 2023 close $0.615. Educational only, not financial advice.
